remarks: A rare gem - step into the timeless charm of this Rufus Wakeman home, a quintessential c.1884 home nestled in Westport, CT. Set on a beautiful, level, professionally landscaped, and private 0.82-acre lot, this cherished residence seamlessly blends historic character with modern-day comfort. High ceilings, intricate moldings, and wide plank floors showcase the craftsmanship of a bygone era, while oversized windows flood the home with natural light. The inviting entryway features a bespoke oversized front door and the original handcrafted stairway banister. Gracious living and dining rooms are complemented by a cozy den and a sun-filled home office. The kitchen, dining area, and family room seamlessly flow onto the spacious patio and lush backyard, creating the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor living. The second floor hosts the private living quarters, featuring spacious bedrooms designed for comfort and tranquility. This level includes three full bathrooms, thoughtfully appointed to provide convenience and privacy for family and guests alike. An added perk - a classic barn at the edge of the property awaits your personal touch. Whether transformed into a guest cottage, studio, workspace, or gym, it offers endless possibilities. Ideally located just minutes from Saugatuck Center, Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, and downtown Westport. This timeless home offers not just a place to live, but a way of life you'll love and never want to leave.
